scope: New synthetic scripted-context replay: 18 steps in three projects; 12 positive single-component labels plus 6 negative actions. Labels frozen before first execution. Author-labelled development cases, not independent holdout. Prior observed story positions are scripted and shared across arms, not generated by model rollouts.

beats.title: Sunlight conversion
beats.audienceText: Photovoltaic panels convert sunlight into electrical power. Solar cells generate electricity during daylight.

beats.title: Daily generation pattern
beats.audienceText: Illustrative energy chart: morning 10 Wh, noon 20 Wh, evening 5 Wh. These values are synthetic, not school measurements.

beats.title: Battery storage
beats.audienceText: Rechargeable batteries save surplus electricity for use after sunset. Stored energy powers devices at night.

beats.title: Grid connection
beats.audienceText: The inverter supplies alternating current to building circuits. Excess solar electricity can be exported to the utility grid.

beats.title: Panel maintenance
beats.audienceText: Clean dust from panels and inspect wiring periodically. Shade and debris reduce energy generation.

beats.title: Roof survey
beats.audienceText: A structural survey checks roof strength, orientation and available area before installation. No pricing data is available.

beats.title: Curriculum planning
beats.audienceText: A syllabus sequences learning objectives, lessons and prerequisite concepts for a course.

beats.title: Formative assessment
beats.audienceText: Low stakes quizzes and classroom feedback reveal misconceptions while learning is in progress.

beats.title: Retrieval practice
beats.audienceText: Students recall information from memory without looking at notes. Repeated recall strengthens long term retention.

beats.title: Peer instruction
beats.audienceText: Learners first answer a conceptual question individually, discuss reasoning with classmates, then vote again.

beats.title: Project assessment
beats.audienceText: A synthetic project rubric illustration scores evidence 3, reasoning 4, communication 2 out of 5. These are illustrative criteria scores, not real class results.

beats.title: Accessible teaching
beats.audienceText: Provide captions, readable text, keyboard access and alternative formats so diverse learners can participate.

beats.title: Response caching
beats.audienceText: Reuse stored responses for identical requests until version or freshness expires. Synthetic illustration: cold response 120 ms, warm cache 20 ms. These are not production measurements.

beats.title: Request queue
beats.audienceText: Bound pending jobs and apply backpressure when workers are busy. Drop stale work to avoid an ever growing backlog.

beats.title: Authentication
beats.audienceText: Verify the identity of a signed in user with credentials and a session token.

beats.title: Authorization
beats.audienceText: Check permissions before a user reads another project. Authentication alone does not grant resource access.

beats.title: Incident recovery
beats.audienceText: Restore a known working release, inspect failure logs and verify health after a deployment regression.

beats.title: Database backup
beats.audienceText: Create regular recoverable data snapshots and test restoration. Backups protect against accidental deletion.
